title: DASight: visual machine learning applied to DAS data classification
description: DASight.jl is an open-source Julia package for image-based machine learning classification of Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) data. It converts DAS recordings into standardised 224 × 224 images and uses trained convolutional neural networks (ResNets) to classify them as signal or noise. The package provides three main tools: PAINTER for processing DAS recordings into images, DETECTIVE for classifying image collections using three trained networks (ZEUS, POSEIDON and HADES) and a weighted voting procedure, and WATCHER for continuous monitoring and classification of incoming DAS files. DASight is designed for screening large DAS datasets, identifying recordings containing signals of interest, and reducing data volume while preserving relevant events. It supports NetCDF and JLD2 data through DASVader.jl and provides both a Julia API and shell-based workflows.
